nodes.name: AIPAC Hostile Takeover of TPUSA Claim
nodes.description: The host's statement, prompted by a viewer comment, that APAC has already taken over or been taking over Turning Point USA, with evidence promised but not yet given.

claims.label: Standard TPUSA Advance-Planning Timeline
claims.claim: A Turning Point USA email dated October 2023 shows that planning for an April 2024 campus tour was already underway approximately five to six months in advance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full October 2023 TPUSA email thread and cross-reference against typical event-planning SOPs for prior TPUSA tours.

claims.label: UVU Request Timing Deviation
claims.claim: A UVU request for Charlie Kirk to speak on campus was received in mid-July 2025 and approved approximately six weeks later for a September 2025 event date, deviating from the standard TPUSA multi-month planning window.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original UVU event request correspondence and TPUSA internal approval records to verify exact dates.

claims.label: Mamdani Foreign-Trip Debate Response
claims.claim: In the NYC mayoral debate, Zohran Mamdani stated he would remain in New York City rather than take a first foreign trip as mayor.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full unedited debate transcript or video to verify the exact wording and any follow-up exchanges.

claims.label: CNN Characterizations of Candace Owens
claims.claim: A CNN segment aired in July 2025 contained on-air characterizations of Candace Owens including "disgusting," "anti-semite," "anti-gay," and claims about statements on slavery history.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named CNN panelists and confirm the original broadcast date and full segment.

claims.label: Brett Cooper Commentary on Randy Fine
claims.claim: Brett Cooper stated on-record that Randy Fine cares more about Israel than free-speech principles, cited his anti-Netanyahu-handshake behavior and his bill introductions, and advised him to move to Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Brett Cooper video for full context and identify any subsequent Fine response.

claims.label: Host Concurs with Brett Cooper on Randy Fine
claims.claim: The host explicitly endorses Brett Cooper's characterization of Randy Fine, calling her commentary "pretty sound advice."
claims.investigative_direction: N/A – host-stance claim linked to source artifact.

claims.label: Brett Cooper Commentary on Ted Cruz
claims.claim: Brett Cooper publicly criticized Ted Cruz for hypocrisy in his treatment of "Nazi" rhetoric, citing specific Cruz tweets.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the cited Ted Cruz tweets in their original form and timestamp.

claims.label: Host Concurs with Brett Cooper on Ted Cruz
claims.claim: The host endorses Brett Cooper's criticism of Ted Cruz's tweet behavior.
claims.investigative_direction: N/A – host-stance claim linked to source artifact.

claims.label: Wexler "White Candace" Post
claims.claim: An X post attributed to Aaron Wexler referred to Brett Cooper as "white Candace" and questioned the use of the term "Nazi."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original Wexler post, account status (active/deleted), and any subsequent responses.

claims.label: Witchcraft Allegation Posts Targeting Brett Cooper
claims.claim: Multiple X posts alleged Brett Cooper and her mother engage in witchcraft, citing a prior interview clip as evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original poster accounts and verify the original posts.

claims.label: Brett Cooper Shawn Ryan Appearance
claims.claim: Brett Cooper appeared on the Shawn Ryan Show and discussed her mother's visits to mediums following the death of her twin brother.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full Shawn Ryan Show episode for complete context and date verification.

claims.label: Blake Nef Recounts Mikey McCoy's Actions
claims.claim: Blake Nef stated on-record that he was next to Mikey McCoy when the shot occurred, that Mikey ran in a specific direction, that his lip was quivering, and that Mikey placed calls to Erica Kirk and to Robin McCoy within approximately one minute.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm publication date and outlet of the Blake Nef interview; cross-reference with available video footage of Mikey McCoy's post-shooting movements.

claims.label: Host Disputes Mikey McCoy Phone Call Account
claims.claim: The host asserts that Blake Nef's account is internally inconsistent with observed video footage of Mikey McCoy's movement and phone posture, and contends that the described calls could not have occurred as described.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and analyze the post-shooting footage showing Mikey McCoy's movements and phone usage against Nef's timeline.

claims.label: Laura Loomer Pentagon Press Pass Headline
claims.claim: A news headline reports that Laura Loomer, described as a Trump ally, has been issued a new Pentagon press pass.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original outlet, publication date, and Pentagon confirmation status.

claims.label: Josh Hammer 9/11 Anniversary Commentary
claims.claim: Josh Hammer stated on-record that the election of a Muslim mayor in New York City less than a quarter century after September 11, 2001 is significant, framing Mamdani's candidacy in those terms.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original Josh Hammer segment and identify the outlet.

claims.label: Host Rejects Josh Hammer Framing
claims.claim: The host publicly rejects Josh Hammer's framing, identifies herself as more fearful of Zionists than Muslims, and refuses the implied call to armed conflict.
claims.investigative_direction: N/A – host-stance claim linked to source artifact.

claims.label: CNN Exit Poll Jewish Vote Share
claims.claim: A CNN exit poll of approximately 4,700 respondents indicates Zohran Mamdani received approximately 32% of the Jewish vote in the NYC mayoral election.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full CNN exit poll crosstabs and methodology to verify exact figures and sample composition.

claims.label: YouTube Channel First-Scheduled Post Selection
claims.claim: Upon resumption of scheduled uploads to his YouTube page following the memorial event, the first scheduled post featured Mikey McCoy (and his wife), with Erika Kirk's speech scheduled second.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify YouTube scheduling metadata for the relevant timeframe.

claims.label: Host Allegation of Equipment Box and Absence of First Aid
claims.claim: The host alleges that Charlie Kirk was positioned on top of an equipment box/suitcase rather than flat on the ground after being lowered, that no first aid was visibly administered, and that Mikey McCoy's phone posture in footage is inconsistent with the official cover-his-ears narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and analyze the full UVU scene footage from multiple angles; locate any official first-aid or security-team accounts; verify equipment-box presence in pre-event setup imagery.

claims.label: UVU Approval as First Stop Unprecedented in Host's Tour Experience
claims.claim: The host says UVU's mid-July request for Charlie Kirk was immediately approved and scheduled as his first stop some six weeks later, and that this has never happened in the history of her campus tours.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA's campus-tour approval records for fall 2025 and compare request-to-approval intervals for other stops with UVU's.
claims.transcript_snippet: That has never happened in the history of my having done campus tours.

claims.label: Host and Kirk Toured Together in April 2024 and Split Stops
claims.claim: The host says she and Charlie Kirk went on a campus tour together in April 2024 and split certain locations so as many places across the United States as possible were covered.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the April 2024 tour schedule showing which stops each of them covered.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie and I went on tour in April of 2024 together.

claims.label: Oct 2023 Email Lists UNC, Pittsburgh and Alabama as Pending Spring Events
claims.claim: The host says the October 2023 planning email listed the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, the University of Pittsburgh and the University of Alabama as pending end-of-March and early-April events, and that she thinks the first two were held.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full October 2023 email and compare it with the actual spring 2024 tour dates and venues.
claims.transcript_snippet: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, which I think we ended up doing.

claims.label: TPUSA Does Not Approve Events Instantly; Spring Requests Roll to Fall
claims.claim: The host says events are not instantly approved at Turning Point USA, that requests it could not fulfil in spring were rolled over to campuses the following fall semester, and that planning runs far in advance because Charlie Kirk travels constantly.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA event-planning SOPs or former tour staff accounts on approval lead times and rollover practice.
claims.transcript_snippet: You don't you don't instantly get approved for an event at Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Approval Speed Points to Inside Job and TPUSA Involvement
claims.claim: The host says the speed of the UVU approval reeks of an inside job and that, because TPUSA is giving no clarity, it is somehow involved at some layer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA and UVU correspondence on the request and approval; identify who approved it and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: It reeks of an inside job.

claims.label: Second Utah Stop Planned Ten Days After September 10
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was slated to speak in Utah on September 10 and return ten days later to a different Utah campus under two hours away, and that TPUSA normally does campus events back to back in a sweep, as with UCLA, Berkeley and Stanford.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the fall 2025 tour schedule, including the second Utah campus stop and its booking date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie was slated to speak in Utah on September 10th and then was due to return just 10 days later to a different campus in Utah.

claims.label: Host Says Apparent Plan Was to Kill Kirk and Take Over His Brand
claims.claim: The host says it looks to her as though the apparent plan was to assassinate Charlie Kirk, who she says had faltered on the pro-Israel cause (his words, not hers), and then stage a hostile takeover of his brand and legacy.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source of Kirk's own words on faltering on the pro-Israel cause and document any takeover steps at TPUSA after September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's looking to me like the apparent plan was to assassinate Charlie Kirk, who had at long last faltered on the pro-Israel cause.

claims.label: Susie Wiles Eulogized Kirk; Host Calls Memorial an Effective Trump Rally
claims.claim: The host says Susie Wiles made it onto the stage to eulogize Charlie Kirk at the memorial and that the event was turned into an effective Trump rally.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the memorial speaker list and transcript of the speeches.
claims.transcript_snippet: we've turned uh this event into an effective Trump rally.

claims.label: Host Says McCoy Told Americans Kirk Wrote a Succession Plan in Notebooks
claims.claim: The host says Pastor Rob McCoy told Americans that Charlie Kirk kept notebooks and diaries in which he wrote a succession plan, and she sarcastically retells it as a notebook describing Mikey McCoy with adjectives like "fantastic" and "heroic".
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain McCoy's original statement and any notebook pages or provenance for the succession plan.
claims.transcript_snippet: it just so happened that Charlie Kirk kept notebooks and diaries.

claims.label: Host Says Notebooks Were Never Going to Be Open to the Public
claims.claim: The host says the public is not going to be allowed to read Charlie Kirk's notebooks but is expected to accept that others read them, and that a succession plan would normally be formalized in a will drawn up by one of his lawyers, which she assumes he had.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA for access to or custody records of the notebooks; check probate or estate filings for a will.
claims.transcript_snippet: the ghost of Charlie's notebooks that were never going to be allowed to read, but we're supposed to accept that they most definitely read.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Is Portrayed as Wanting Anger at Tucker and Silence on His Murder
claims.claim: The host says the public is supposed to think Charlie Kirk would want people to be mad at Tucker Carlson and to stop speaking about his murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who has publicly stated that Kirk would want this, and the exact words used.
claims.transcript_snippet: we're supposed to think that he would want us to be mad at Tucker Carlson and that he would want us to stop speaking about his murder

claims.label: Mamdani Beat Cuomo Despite Money; Republicans Earlier Called Cuomo Corrupt
claims.claim: The host says Zohran Mamdani won pretty handily against Andrew Cuomo despite billionaire money flowing into the anti-Mamdani campaign, and that Republicans had recently called Cuomo unbelievably corrupt and said he should be in prison.
claims.investigative_direction: Check certified NYC mayoral results and the dated Republican statements about Cuomo.
claims.transcript_snippet: He won pretty handily against Andrew Cuomo, which like 5 minutes ago, the Republican party was telling us he was unbelievably corrupt and that he should be in prison.

claims.label: Host Says Bill Ackman Gave $1.75 Million Against Mamdani
claims.claim: The host says Bill Ackman gave $1.75 million in the effort against Zohran Mamdani and at times demanded a debate with him, and that Mamdani won regardless.
claims.investigative_direction: Check super PAC and campaign finance filings for Ackman's contributions in the 2025 NYC mayoral race.
claims.transcript_snippet: Bill gave 1.75 million and Mom Donnie won irrespective of the money that was donated against him.

claims.label: Host Lists Bloomberg, Gebbia and Tisch Family Spending Against Mamdani
claims.claim: The host says Michael Bloomberg gave $8.3 million to a Cuomo-affiliated super PAC, Airbnb co-founder Joseph Gebbia gave $3.1 million, and the Tisch family gave $1.2 million, and that Mamdani still won.
claims.investigative_direction: Check NYC Campaign Finance Board and super PAC filings for each donor's contribution.
claims.transcript_snippet: He gave $8.3 million to Stop Mand Donnie and it didn't matter.

claims.label: Debate Clip: Cuomo Says He Would Go to Israel First
claims.claim: In the debate clip, Andrew Cuomo says that, given hostility and anti-semitism in New York, he would go to Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the unedited mayoral debate video and confirm which candidate gave each answer.
claims.transcript_snippet: given the hostility and the anti-semitism that has been uh shown in New York, I would go to Israel.

claims.label: Debate Clip: Candidate Says Fourth Trip to Israel, Fifth to Ukraine
claims.claim: In the debate clip, a candidate addressed as "Mr. Tilson" says he would make his fourth trip to Israel followed by his fifth trip to Ukraine, which he calls two of the greatest allies.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the unedited debate video to identify the candidate the transcript renders as "Mr. Tilson".
claims.transcript_snippet: I'd make my fourth trip to Israel, followed by my fifth trip to Ukraine

claims.label: Debate Clip: Mamdani Answer on Israel's Right to Exist
claims.claim: In the debate clip, asked "Do you believe in a Jewish state of Israel?", Zohran Mamdani answers that he believes Israel has the right to exist, with the clip's speakers disputing whether he will say it as a Jewish state.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the unedited debate video and compare the exact exchange with the host's characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: Do you believe in a Jewish state of Israel? >> I believe Israel has the right to exist

claims.label: Host Says Only Ramaswamy Skipped the Israeli Flag Pin in Presidential Debates
claims.claim: The host says that during the Republican presidential debates most candidates wore an Israeli flag pin and that only Vivek Ramaswamy did not.
claims.investigative_direction: Review debate footage and photographs for which candidates wore Israeli pins.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was only only Vik Ramoswami was not wearing the Israeli pin.

claims.label: Host Says NYC Has Largest Jewish Population Outside Israel; Mamdani Took a Large Share
claims.claim: The host says New York has the largest Jewish population of any city in the world outside Israel and that Mamdani, while not winning the Jewish vote, got too much of it.
claims.investigative_direction: Check city Jewish population estimates and the exit-poll breakdown by religion.
claims.transcript_snippet: New York has the largest population of Jewish people of any city in the world next to Israel.

claims.label: Mark Says Exit Poll Shows Israel Was a Factor for Many Voters
claims.claim: Mark Herman says the CNN exit poll shows that Israel was a factor in a lot of voters' choices.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the CNN exit poll crosstabs for the Israel-related question.
claims.transcript_snippet: you can see that Israel was a factor in a lot of these people's votes.

claims.label: Host Says Trump Posted 900 Percent More About Defeating Mamdani Than Finding Kirk's Killer
claims.claim: The host says President Trump dedicated 900 percent more Truth Social posts to ensuring Mamdani would lose than to ensuring Charlie Kirk's murderer was found.
claims.investigative_direction: Count Trump's Truth Social posts on Mamdani and on the Kirk investigation over the same period.
claims.transcript_snippet: President Trump dedicated 900% more truth social uh posts to ensuring that Mandani would lose than to ensuring that Charlie Kirk's murderer was found.

claims.label: Host Says Trump Sent No Message About Investigating Kirk's Murder
claims.claim: The host says Donald Trump did not send even one message about investigating Charlie Kirk's murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Search Trump's Truth Social posts since September 10 for any reference to investigating Kirk's murder.
claims.transcript_snippet: he didn't even send one message about uh investigating Charlie's murder.

claims.label: Host Says MAGA Fractured When Trump Said "Epstein, Who?"
claims.claim: The host says MAGA fractured not when Tucker Carlson interviewed Nick Fuentes but when Donald Trump said "Epsteeen, who?".
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Trump's dated "Epstein, who?" remark in the original interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: MAGA got fractured. Not when Tucker Carlson interviewed Nick Fuentes, but when Donald Trump looked at us in our faces

claims.label: Host Says Brett Cooper Encouraged New Yorkers to Vote Against Mamdani
claims.claim: The host says Brett Cooper did her part and encouraged New Yorkers to get out and vote against Mamdani, and was still attacked after one critique.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Cooper's pre-election video urging New Yorkers to vote.
claims.transcript_snippet: Zionist wanted her do her part and encourage New Yorkers to get out and vote against Mam Donnie.

claims.label: Host Says Cooper Watched the Republican Jewish Coalition Event Targeting Tucker
claims.claim: The host says Brett Cooper watched the Republican Jewish Coalition event about Tucker Carlson not being MAGA and agreed that demands to censor and deplatform are childish and ineffective.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Republican Jewish Coalition event recording and Cooper's reaction video.
claims.transcript_snippet: she watched the totally deranged Tucker is not MAGA Republican Jewish coalition event

claims.label: Cooper Clip: Fine Bragged About Not Washing Hands After Netanyahu, Went to Anger Management
claims.claim: In the clip, Brett Cooper says Randy Fine bragged about not washing his hands after shaking Netanyahu's hand, has repeatedly introduced bills to criminalize anti-semitism, and had to go through anger management classes a few years ago.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Fine's handshake remark and anger-management reporting in primary sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: considering you had to go through anger management classes a few years ago, I genuinely think you would probably be happier if you just moved to Israel.

claims.label: Cooper Clip: Quotes Two Ted Cruz Tweets on "Nazi"
claims.claim: In the clip, Brett Cooper reads two Ted Cruz tweets: one a month earlier saying they call you a Nazi so they can kill you and that political violence is a left-wing phenomenon, and a later one in response to Fuentes and Tucker saying Trump's bombing of the Ayatollah's nuclear facilities "made the little Nazi mad".
claims.investigative_direction: Locate both Ted Cruz tweets and their dates on X.
